evals.prompt: I'm giving keynote-pro/examples/tech-talk.html at a meetup for junior front-end devs, I have 10 minutes including questions. Is it right for them?
evals.expected_output: Runs deck-stats, compares ~5 min estimate with a 10-min slot incl. Q&A, flags backend jargon (p99, etc.) for junior FE devs, top fixes with slide numbers, offers to apply.

evals.prompt: review keynote-pro/examples/quarterly-review.html for a 20 minute slot with the board
evals.expected_output: Verdict, timing vs 20 min (deck is ~5 min: says what is missing rather than padding), checks sources and the decision ask, does not edit the deck.

evals.prompt: review keynote-pro/examples/quarterly-review.html using the MIT speaking rules from Patrick Winston, it's for a 15 minute board meeting
evals.expected_output: Reads references/winston.md; scorecard by area (start, during, slides, memorable, persuading, stop); flags the 'Questions' final slide (13) and suggests a contributions/decision slide; checks for an empowerment promise in slides 1-2 and signposts (agenda slide 2, section 7); notes wordy slides 4, 10, 12; doesn't edit the deck.
